mbo_verdict:
MAXIMUM-ABSORPTION ROUND TRIP, ON THE FINAL DAY OF THE INDEX-ROLL WINDOW. The session is not ambiguous once the flow is put next to the price. Aggressors bought +6,326 net across 72,162 lots - the block's largest tilt by 69 percent - and closed the day 60 dollars LOWER. Phase by phase: ph1 +116 of flow for +10 of price (nothing, on 5.6 percent of volume); ph2 +2,868 for +40 (14 dollars of price per thousand units of net flow); ph3 +3,342 for -120, flow_conviction NEGATIVE, ph_absorb TRUE. The buying was continuously and completely absorbed, and the absorption got STRONGER as the session went on - the only phase where net buying accelerated is the phase where price went down.
The mechanism is the program. 0715 is BCOM roll day 5 of 5: a long-index roll SELLS the front leg, and a seller working a large resting order all day is exactly a book that prints aggressor-BUY on every lift while never letting price go bid. That is flow.resting_program_inverts_aggressor_tilt's stated mechanism, on the day it should fire, and its fingerprint here is near-identical to the instance the play was built on: G21 0608 ph2 = +2,858 of buy against -120 of price; G23 0715 ph2 = +2,868 of buy against +40. Ten units of flow apart.
The 14:39 turn is the completion. Once the crowd's buying was spent - and it had bought the block's largest tilt into a market that would not move - there was no bid underneath it, and the tape bled 2.941 -> 2.900 in one continuous leg through the settle and into the evening reopen, with no bounce. The exit is an ALIGNED SELL (last_hour_dir -1 with last_hour_signed_flow -1): the absorber stopped absorbing and started selling with the tape. That is a spent BUYER, and it is what 0716 inherits.
The complement to D's 0709 finding is exact and I think it is the block's real lesson. 0709 ph2: 98,400 lots, net flow -11, price -1,860 - perfectly balanced flow, enormous move, no resting base to arrest it. 0715 ph2+ph3: 68,115 lots, net flow +6,210, price -80 - enormous imbalanced flow, no move, inexhaustible resting offer. Same contract, same week, six sessions apart, and the price delivered per unit of net aggressor flow differs by a factor of 147 (1.322 against 0.009). Net signed flow therefore carries almost no magnitude information on its own; the state that governs magnitude is the resting-depth regime, and the two are independent. 0709 and 0715 are the two tails of one axis.

run_directive_targets_addressed.target_1_what_owned_the_blocks_down_move:
THE WINDOW STORY SURVIVES MY DAY - and my day is INSIDE it, not after it, which strengthens it. Correcting the calendar (0715 = in_bcom_roll, day 5 of 5) re-partitions the block: the program window is 0708-0715, six sessions, summing -3,710 (-520, -2,050, -660, -620, +200, -60); the clean remainder is 0706, 0707, 0716, 0717, four sessions, summing +420. Per day: -618 in-window against +105 out. The same partition holds in g21 with the same calendar rule - in-program 0608-0612 sums -790 over 5 days (-158/day), out-of-program 0615-0619 sums +570 (+114/day) - and g22, which has no program window at all, runs +470 over 10 days (+47/day). Three groups, and the out-of-window day-mean is positive in every one.
TWO HONEST QUALIFICATIONS I will not suppress. First, 0709 alone is -2,050 of g23's -3,710, i.e. 55 percent of the window's whole decline, and it is the EIA print day; ex-0709 the window runs -332/day, still negative but no longer dramatic. Second, the window contains real positive days (g23 0714 +200 on roll day 4 of 5; g21 0609 +70, 0610 +490, 0612 +620), so this is a WINDOW-SUM statement and never a per-day sign rule.
WHAT MY DAY ADDS IS THE MECHANISM, and it corrects the story's usual telling. The window's signature is NOT selling pressure. On 0715 the market bought harder than on any other day of the block - the largest aggressor tilt of the ten sessions - and could not close up. The window supplies a resting OFFER that converts buying into nothing; it does not supply selling. The measurable is the transfer function, and it collapses inside the window: usd-per-unit-net-flow reads 0.053 (0714), 0.009 (0715), 0.018 (0716, still digesting) - the three lowest of the block - against 0.158 and 0.092 on the clean pre-window days 0706 and 0707. That reading is also why a roll, which is a calendar-spread trade with no business moving the outright, can still own a block: it does not push price down, it removes the market's ability to go up, and any bearish catalyst arriving inside the window (0709) then runs undefended.
run_directive_targets_addressed.target_2_the_0709_print_liquidity_void:
MY DAY CORROBORATES D, AND SUPPLIES ITS MIRROR. D's read - the print was about 5 percent of the move, 59 percent pre-print, and the mechanism was a liquidity-void reprice of -1,860 on -11 of net flow across 98,400 lots into a mid book with no short base to arrest it - is a statement that PRICE MOVED WITHOUT FLOW. 0715 is the same transfer function failing in the opposite direction: FLOW MOVED WITHOUT PRICE. +6,210 of net aggressor buy across 68,115 lots in ph2+ph3 for -80 of price.
Quantified on the same axis, same contract, six sessions apart: usd per unit of net aggressor flow = 1.322 on 0709 against 0.009 on 0715, a factor of 147; usd per 1,000 lots traded = 13.21 against 0.83, a factor of 16. Those are the two extremes of the ten-day block on both normalisations.
THE CONSEQUENCE, which I think is the most transferable thing in this block: net signed flow carries essentially NO magnitude information by itself. The same +1,500-to-+6,000 range of net buying produced -2,050 (0709) and -60 (0715). What governs magnitude is the resting-depth regime, and depth is independent of the flow you can measure. This is also why D's finding and mine cannot be averaged into one 'flow matters this much' coefficient - they are per-event readings of a state variable that swung by two orders of magnitude inside one week.
Where I cannot help D: the resting-depth regime is precisely the book question, and the g23 book layer is stood down for want of the two missing staged files. Both of us are inferring depth from its price consequences rather than observing it.

GENERAL-MECHANISM CONTRIBUTIONS (proposal text only, no brain edit). Each carries per-event instances, counterexamples, scope, n, and a falsifier. Nothing here is offered as established.

(1) PRICE_FREE_ABSORPTION_PROXY - SCOPE REPAIR, NOT REFUTATION. n=9 fires spanning G20, G21, G22, G23.
CLAIM: the big-print channel carries information only in its TAILS, and the fitted 0.547 bar sits inside the noise. Per event, never pooled as the conclusion - readings at or below 0.47 under positive aggregate flow: G20 0602 bp 0.436 -> -80; G22 0625 bp 0.466 -> -60; G23 0710 bp 0.454 -> -660. Three of three non-positive, spanning three groups. The one decisive clear above the bar: G20 0603 bp 0.585 -> +750, one of one. The five readings in between: G21 0609 bp 0.498 -> +70; G22 0626 bp 0.499 -> +230; G23 0708 bp 0.535 -> -520; G23 0715 bp 0.553 -> -60; G23 0716 bp 0.555 -> -20. Two up, three down, no ordering.
PROPOSED FORM: absorber PRESENT at bp <= 0.47 (keep, n=3 spanning three groups); absorber GONE at bp >= 0.58 (n=1, insufficient, hold as a candidate); NO CALL in 0.47 < bp < 0.58.
WHY THE ASYMMETRY IS PRINCIPLED and not curve-fitting: 'big prints still selling under a buying count tape' is a DIRECT observation of a resting seller. 'Big prints flipping buy' is only the ABSENCE of that observation, and absence is not evidence the seller left - it is equally evidence the seller stopped needing to print. G23 0715 is that argument's sharpest instance: 0714's big prints flipped buy at 0.553 and the very next session produced the block's largest absorption event, +6,326 of net buy for -60. The absorber had never gone anywhere.
CONFOUND I CANNOT SEPARATE AND WILL NOT HIDE: split by program contamination instead of by extremity, the proxy's clean-input fires go 4 of 5 and its program-input fires go 1 of 4 - exactly what resting_program_inverts_aggressor_tilt's consequence guard predicts. Two of the four program fires ARE the marginal clears, so the two explanations are collinear at n=9. Both are on the table; neither is established. RESOLVING MEASUREMENT: find a fire with a marginal reading (0.50-0.56) on a CLEAN D-1, or a decisive reading (<=0.47 or >=0.58) on a PROGRAM D-1. Neither exists in g20-g23.
FALSIFIER: a bp <= 0.47 fire under positive aggregate flow that delivers a materially positive day, or a run of no-call-band readings that orders correctly.

(2) INDEX-ROLL WINDOW BLOCK LEAN - CORRECTED CALENDAR AND A CORRECTED MECHANISM. n=2 spanning G21 and G23, with G22 as a clean silent control.
CALENDAR CORRECTION FIRST, because it revises the tables already written into g23's 0708 refine file: the window must be the UNION of in_gsci_roll, in_bcom_roll and in_bcom_hedge_roll, not the GSCI leg alone. The legs are offset - in G23, GSCI runs 0708-0714 and BCOM runs 0709-0715 - so 20260715 is IN the window (bcom_roll_day_n 5) and was previously counted out of it. Corrected per event: G23 in-window 0708 -520, 0709 -2,050, 0710 -660, 0713 -620, 0714 +200, 0715 -60 = -3,710 over six sessions; G23 out 0706 +100, 0707 +160, 0716 -20, 0717 +180 = +420 over four. G21 in-window 0608 -890, 0609 +70, 0610 +490, 0611 -1,080, 0612 +620 = -790 over five; G21 out 0615 +160, 0616 +970, 0617 -970, 0618 +520, 0619 -110 = +570 over five. G22 has no program window on any of the three flags and sums +470 over ten. Out-of-window day-means: +105 (G23), +114 (G21), +47 (G22) - positive in all three.
MECHANISM CORRECTION, which is what my day contributes: the window does not SELL, it CAPS. On 0715, the window's final session, aggressors bought the block's largest tilt (+6,326 net across 72,162 lots) and the day closed -60. The measurable is the transfer function - usd of day-move per unit of net aggressor flow - and it collapses inside the window: 0714 0.053, 0715 0.009, 0716 0.018 (the three lowest of the block, being the last two program sessions plus the digestion day) against 0.158 and 0.092 on the clean pre-window sessions 0706 and 0707. This is why a calendar-spread trade with no business moving the outright can still own a block: it does not push price down, it removes the market's ability to go UP, and a bearish catalyst arriving inside the window (0709, alone 55 percent of G23's window decline) then runs undefended.
SCOPE, tight: a WINDOW-SUM / block-lean statement, never a per-day sign rule. Named counterexamples: G23 0714 +200 on roll day 4, G21 0610 +490, G21 0612 +620.
FALSIFIER: a staged block whose union-window sums POSITIVE while its non-window remainder sums negative; or a window whose transfer function does NOT compress relative to its own block's clean days.
REQUIRED MEASUREMENT before promotion: stage the next-month leg (NGU26 here) so roll flow can be separated from outright liquidation. Until then the mechanism is inferred from the outright's transfer function alone.

(3) THE BURN GATE IS A FLOW INSTRUMENT, NOT A PRICE INSTRUMENT - proposed as a MEASUREMENT TO RUN, not as a play to fire. n=1 clean instance; deliberately under-claimed.
CLAIM: est_gas_burn_bcfd and the CDD ladder describe how much gas gets bought; they say nothing about whether that buying clears. Re-aim the gate at the ORDER FLOW and stop asking it for price.
THE ONE CLEAN INSTANCE is G23 0715, and it is clean because both readings are block extremes on the same day: block-max burn 47.2, block-min solar, wind off, every forward run-delta warm - and the block-max aggressor buy flow, +6,326, 69 percent above the next-largest. WHY I AM NOT PROPOSING THIS AS A RULE: I have one instance, and the block's burn and flow ranks elsewhere do not obviously line up (0717 carries the highest burn of all, 51.0, on a +1,333 tilt). The proposal is to MEASURE rank(burn) against rank(session_signed_flow) across staged groups before anyone writes a rule, and to stop scoring the gate against price in the meantime.
WHAT IS ESTABLISHED, separately and firmly: the gate's PRICE claim is refuted. (4b) NO FORWARD-CDD-SLOPE RESCUE OF THE BURN GATE.
